# 1.3.0
Bump: minor

- Prefer FUSE and support an eager ordinary-directory fallback only when FUSE is concretely unavailable and `--write-policy=all` was explicitly selected. Preserve native Git resolution, verification, pinned tree identity, bytes, links and executable modes. Fail before execution on unsupported entries or host filesystem representation limits. Materialization reads the entire tree and can cost startup time, network traffic and temporary disk space.
- Remove `--keep` and `-k` before the command separator. Each execution snapshot is disposable; write required logs and artifacts to explicit paths outside it. Child arguments after `--` remain literal. This removal is explicitly accepted as a minor-version exception while the project has no affected external users.
- Add the native Apple Silicon artifact and official macFUSE MFMount/FSKit transport, without a kernel extension. Startup/explicit-all materialization needs macOS 13+; FSKit mounts need 15.4+, and read-only policy requires the newer 26.4+ API with macFUSE 5.5+ (currently prerelease). Owners must provision the official framework/application/helpers and activate its user-space extension; quiet mount mode does not authorize installation. Real FSKit acceptance remains required. FSKit lacks a per-file fsync callback; persistent databases belong outside the disposable tree, and full sync/durability equivalence is not promised.
- Add optional Linux kernel FUSE passthrough for physically backed command-generated regular files. Unsupported kernels and unprivileged runs retain ordinary FUSE I/O. Git source blobs and copied-up tracked files remain outside this optimization. The child receives no added privileges; command and mount teardown stay synchronous.
- Adopt pinned cargo-dist 0.33.0 artifacts and generated installers, corrected to fail closed on archive SHA-256 verification, including macOS `shasum -a 256`. Preserve https://sh.progbeat.dev/git-on and the thin dispatcher's `--version`/`--bin-dir` interface. Only 1.3.0 and later are supported; `--github-cli` is removed with a migration diagnostic. Published old releases are untouched.
